run_a_star_shortest_path: run the A* shortest path generator for embodied QA navigation across 3D house environments
run_heuristic_estimate: run the heuristic_estimate function to compute Euclidean distance between agent and target continuous coordinates
run_add_neighbors: run the add_neighbors function to expand A* search with rotation and forward movement candidates
run_main: run the main function with argparse to generate shortest paths for all environment-question pairs in a JSON file
review_add_neighbors: review the add_neighbors function that handles angle rotation and forward movement edge expansion in A* search
